scope: Atomic public route navigation, admin lazy-module recovery and numeric editing, reference-centred volume estimates for open surfaces. No selling rates, auth policies, business content or brand identity changed.

findings: Reference centres mesh before signed tetrahedron sum; there is no closed-surface gate.
Reference computes minimum/setup charges even with zero estimated volume.
Reference embeds fallback prices. Those have not been silently substituted for business rates.

limitations: Browser transition, admin recovery and brand/theme regressions run in CI; this review does not claim their new results yet.
A successful source push is not evidence that every custom domain runs this revision.
Live material prices and general pricing settings must be saved by the owner; no guessed selling rates were written.
historicalEvidence: Existing content, image provenance, all-route and brand reviews are carried forward only for unchanged content. New runtime evidence supplements them.
